steps.action: Stack the two red 2x2 round bricks on the center of the base, on top of the green plates in front of the gray slopes, forming a column.
watch_for: Place both round bricks on top of each other to make a two-high column, not side by side
Center the column between the green plates in front of the gray slope

steps.action: Attach the two blue 1x1 bricks with side studs at the back corners on either side of the gray slope, with the side studs facing outward.
watch_for: Side stud must face outward (left and right), not forward
One brick goes on each side of the gray slope, behind it at the back corners
